_note: Contract specifications read from the MT4 terminal: Market Watch, right-click the symbol, Specification. tick_value_per_lot may be left null when the instrument is quoted in the account currency; it is then derived as contract_size * point. leverage is the account leverage for the instrument, e.g. 20 for a 5 percent margin requirement; when the Specification dialog does not show it, open a position and divide price * contract_size * lots by the margin the terminal reserved.
